TestRestoreWithEaR::test_basic_restore_w.description: 2-node cluster with a KMS-encrypted table ks.cf1 (local-kms docker, KmsKeyProviderFactory); inserts 20 rows, runs a Scylla Manager backup to s3/gcs (minio/fake-gcs), then rotates the KMS master key (create new key, repoint alias), rolling-restarts, runs `nodetool upgradesstables -a` (re-encrypt live sstables with the new key), and restores the old backup (sstables encrypted under the old key) via `sctool restore --restore-tables`. Asserts restore task reaches DONE and rows k1..k20 are readable. Guards that Manager restore (rclone/native load&stream) can load sstables encrypted with a rotated-out KMS key. Parametrized s3/gcs x rclone/native.
